create -b
set brand=lx
set zonepath=/tank/zones/web
set autoboot=true
set ip-type=exclusive
add anet
set linkname=net0
set lower-link=stub0
set allowed-address=10.0.0.5/24
set defrouter=10.0.0.1
set mac-address=02:08:20:a1:b2:c3
set vlan-id=20
end
add capped-cpu
set ncpus=1.5
end
add capped-memory
set physical=2G
end
add rctl
set name=zone.max-lwps
add value (priv=privileged,limit=2000,action=deny)
end
add attr
set name=kernel-version
set type=string
set value=5.10.0
end
add attr
set name=mandrake-id
set type=string
set value="0192a1b2-c3d4-7e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a60"
end
add attr
set name=hostname
set type=string
set value="web"
end
